name: Unreal Engine
title: unrealengine.com
shortDescription: Unreal Engine is a premier software for developers looking to create immersive 3D experiences. Whether you're building games, simulations, or broadcast events, Unreal Engine provides the tools necessary for high-quality production. It's designed for a range of creators from indie game developers to large studios, offering access to source code and a supportive community.
pros: Support for all major platforms and features
cons: Royalty fees on commercial products after certain revenue thresholds
